text:
jess: heads-up: customer reported duplicate provisional tokens after a resumed streaming session. appears snapshot merge (hysteresis) and route fallback both wrote provisional entries. cc @nate

nate: any log snippet? which pools?

jess: snippet: INFO session=abcX resume snapshot=SNAP-99 ttl_expired=true route=pool-1 fallback=pool-2 provisional=40
INFO ledger write provisional session=abcX tokens=40 origin=resume
INFO ledger write provisional session=abcX tokens=40 origin=fallback

karen: two writes in quick succession. dedupe should have prevented this; suspect derived session id mismatch across pools (per-pool HMAC).

sam: true - HMAC secret rotation per pool can cause non-canonical ids until reconciliation.

nate: short-term: add idempotency in ledger.write keyed by canonical_session_id+origin_hint and emit metric "provisional.dedupe.miss" when canonical missing. medium-term: single-merge RPC that canonicalizes inside merge to avoid dual writes.

ops-bot: queued migration job "merge-provisional-hysteresis-collisions-v1" dry-run for 2026-03-15..2026-03-22 estimate ~10k rows.

jess: plan: implement idempotency + metric behind kill-switch, canary to a few pools for 48h, dashboard row for dedupe-miss rate, and migration dry-run. will open PRs.
